subject: TeraRecon/ConcertAI <> Encord | Scaling your annotation pipeline & FDA approval
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well. Met your team at RSNA last year, Brian Marra spoke to my
colleague about the AI models you are developing and some of the struggles
you've had regarding poor annotator quality and traceability for FDA
approval. You sound like you're at the interjection where clients typically
start working with us where they are seeking FDA  approval and need to
improve the efficiency and traceability of their annotations as well as
expand to new modalities and joints.

For some context, Encord is a data development platform for computer vision
& multimodal AI teams, focused on data curation, annotation, workflow
management and model evaluation. We work with the likes of Philips, Viz.ai
and Asesnus Surgical. Our partnership with NIH and the platform's necessary
audit-ability and traceability makes it ideal for FDA approval and reader
studies. We also offer a manager service for annotation where we ensure a
dedicated annotation team to maintain quality (annotators must pass your
requirements in order to be used).

Would you be interested to learn more about how we can help? Wide open
Friday morning. Alternatively I see the ConcertAI team will be at ECR this
year, we could always shoot for the end of the month and meet at ECR?

subject: Build vs buy
text:
